items.docs:
Searches for events from the Tickitto inventory and provides additional metadata about the search result. 

The search endpoint is meant for use with the Tickitto website. 

The search endpoint supports text search as well as filters for different event categories, cities, or countries to create a powerful contextual search experience. 

The endpoint supports pagination via the `skip` and `limit` parameters and the returned `X-Total-Count` header.

params.name: text
params.description: Text to perform a search of events with. Searches event title, city, and performer names.

params.name: skip
params.description: Number of results to skip for pagination; see also `limit` and the `X-Total-Count` response header.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of results to return for pagination; see also `skip` and the `X-Total-Count` response header.

params.name: profile_name
params.description: Profile name

params.name: hostname
params.description: Associated hostname
